insights.title: Trip consistency
insights.description: Organizational checks to help you spot gaps — not a decision on your application.
insights.allClear: No trip issues found. Everything looks consistent.

why.title: Why do we ask this?
why.disclaimer: This is general information to help you prepare, not legal advice.
why.mainDestination: The main destination is usually where you spend the most nights, and it often determines which country's consulate you apply to.
why.insurance: Travel health insurance is commonly expected to cover your whole stay. Recording the coverage window lets us flag gaps against your dates.
